result.summary: The interface contains placeholder-style graphics and minor layout text issues that impact visual polish.

issues.description: Food listings use generic flat illustrations instead of actual food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace stock illustrations with high-quality, real-world photos of dishes.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated mid-word in the horizontal scroll list.
issues.suggestion: Adjust text container size or implement a multi-line label for longer names.

issues.description: Delivery fee information is displayed redundantly as both an image tag and text detail.
issues.suggestion: Consolidate delivery fee indicators to reduce visual clutter on food cards.
